counts.basis: Reviewed source inventory, not generated discovery or executed/passing cases.

authoritativeSources.planCommand: npm run validate -- plan --groups all --browsers all --serial-browser

prerequisites.ordering: typecheck -> preflight -> selected completion-source/storage-environment, node:tooling, python:reviews and python:archives controls -> vendor -> selected python:vendor -> text-inputs -> imports -> required raster/app/server builds -> ordinary Node -> Node-hosted browser -> Playwright
prerequisites.buildFreeToolingScope: The auxiliary node:tooling gate is build-free. The --groups tooling alias also selects qualification and therefore retains its actual server-build prerequisite.

sourceClosure.basis: Reviewed current profile declaration closure, not a second runtime allowlist.

textInputs.requires: Actual current text producer/profile seal before verification; stale recipe/profile/installed inputs fail before builds.
textInputs.kind2Key: Full source plus installed dependency identity; no narrow text-name filter.

networkGuards.tests/session/no-egress.mjs: Other registered Node groups; retain literal IPv4 loopback-only policy and child/worker propagation.

cacheAndResume.prerequisites: Reuse only a successful result with verified source, dependency, output and originating-audit identities. text-inputs is an additive whitelist member.
cacheAndResume.ordinaryTests: Rerun unless explicitly resuming a source-stable audited receipt.
cacheAndResume.freshFixtures: Browser and marked genuine migration fixture gates always rerun, including under --resume.
cacheAndResume.legacyCompilation: The separate archive/dependency compilation cache retains its kind1 identity and immutable byte verification; compiled preparation reuse is not reuse of migration/browser outcomes.
cacheAndResume.freshFlag: --fresh disables prerequisite/build and legacy compilation reuse.
cacheAndResume.excludedOriginalWorkingTreeChanges: Original uncommitted kind3 cache, newer selectors and fast-file lane are not part of this committed-donor reconciliation.

migrationPrerequisites.value: Explicit canonical absolute path; no default or inferred packet.
migrationPrerequisites.propagation: Reviewed bridge forwards the explicit value from parent/core to children.
migrationPrerequisites.admission: Actual schema18 capture plus independent fresh restore and exact product pin must succeed first; installer verifies identity/platform, copies into each private root and invokes product verification.
migrationPrerequisites.callerFreshness: 18 bound migration test callers, 55 direct install sites, one shared prior-writer hook and two explicit legacyMigration reopens remain fresh under resume.

completionSource.requires: Current coordinated source and application build; preserve historical producer/manifest seals, exact emitted classifier checks and independent expected-map assertions.

executionPolicy.optionalPilots: Two workers apply only to qualification; browser batching requires supported per-spec namespaces, fresh contexts and paired equivalence evidence before broader adoption. Native WebKit keeps fresh persistent contexts.
executionPolicy.locks: One checkout output owner plus fixed physical-host timing lock; no source changes during a run.

allocation.meaning: Existing evidence accounting ceiling, not newly reserved capacity or a disk quota.
allocation.policy: Use fresh distinct output leaves and retain unsuccessful receipts.

executionPolicy.stop: Stop at first FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE effective result, missing/failed evidence audit, drift or failed preparation.
executionPolicy.specialized: Performance/resource, cold-install, native/manual and P/Q3 campaigns remain separate and fresh; no correctness work while an exclusive timing campaign owns the host.

pending: Final coordinated source adoption and exact before/source identity checks.
Authentic schema18 capture/independent restore and exact product/schema19 profile seals.
Current-source completion check, text-input verification and current-build emitted issuer preparation.
Selected shared-runner Node and complete serial browser execution with valid evidence audits.
Required paired worker/batch/engine checks and separate specialized qualification; no historical donor result satisfies these.

nextRunRecipe.scope: Retain the reviewed phase ladder and allocation recipe. Its earlier source-reference list is not the final source union: compose later reviewed source successors, including pins02, before execution.

retainedManagedSummary.provenance: Frozen evidence facts relayed by the root coordinator; this document reconciliation did not reread the large receipts or private capture files and did not execute their commands.
retainedManagedSummary.conclusion: Retain the failed and inconclusive evidence. No combined managed PASS, authentic schema18 authority or final schema19 qualification is supplied by these facts.

origin.executionOrigin: Original checkout working tree described by the donor record; not proof of a clean donor commit or this managed integration.
origin.recordedResults: Historical reported results, failures, blockers, paths and limitations are preserved below. Evidence logs/receipts were not reopened, rerun or requalified during this source-only reconciliation.
origin.managedBefore: Absent at source-only comparison; no managed file was overwritten.

record.scope: Read-only static inventory of active working-tree validation; excludes historical evidence copies and vendored binaries. Source may change concurrently. Counts are files/entry points, not passing cases.

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:consumer && npm run typecheck:app && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.server.json
scripts.build: npm run build:consumer && npm run build:app && npm run build:server
scripts.dev: npm run build:app && npm run build:server && npm start
scripts.build:app: npm run verify:imports && node tooling/theme/density.mjs && vite build --config vite.app.config.ts
scripts.test:shell: npm run build:app && npm run build:server && playwright test --config tests/browser/playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:recovery: npm run build:server && vite build --config tests/recovery/vite.config.ts && playwright test --config tests/recovery/playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:raster:browser: npm run build:server && vite build --config tests/raster/vite.config.ts && playwright test --config tests/raster/playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:text: npm run build:server && vite build --config tests/text/vite.config.ts && playwright test --config tests/text/playwright.config.ts

externalReportValidation.scope: Read-only lifecycle inspection; existing independent report reused. Canonical state not copied into audit inventory.

currentInventory.basis: Source-reviewed candidate inventory only; no new plan/discovery was executed.
currentInventory.auxiliaryToolingAndPythonGates: Tracked separately from the23 registered product/helper groups.

browserInventory.basis: Reviewed source inventory, not generated discovery or executed/passing cases.

currentInventory.historicalSnapshot: The original39 scripts,308 Node files,28 configs and908 file-hash rows remain solely in historicalDonor.record; they are not a current managed count or passing coverage.
currentInventory.regeneration: Use the current registry and shared plan/preflight at the authorized execution boundary; do not infer a new generated file list from this historical record.
